test_cases.expected_result: The Grading Workflow page for the selected student submission is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Perform Quick Grading on a submission
steps: 1. Click the action menu for a submission
3. Enter <valid grade> in the grading field
test_cases.expected_result: The grading field updates to reflect the entered grade inline in the table

test_cases.test_case: Filter submissions by Submission Status
steps: 1. Select 'Submitted for grading' from the Submission Status filter
test_cases.expected_result: Only submissions with the status 'Submitted for grading' are displayed in the table; unrelated submissions are no longer visible

test_cases.test_case: Filter submissions by Grading Status
steps: 1. Select 'Graded' from the Grading Status filter
test_cases.expected_result: Only submissions with the grading status 'Graded' are displayed in the table; unrelated submissions are no longer visible

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to open grading workflow without quick grading mode enabled
preconditions: Quick grading mode is not enabled
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; 'Open Grading Workflow' is not available for selection

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to use quick grading when quick grading mode is not enabled
preconditions: Quick grading mode is not enabled
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked; 'Quick Grading' option is not available for selection

test_cases.test_case: Enter a very long string in Submission Comments
steps: 2. Click on the Submission Comments field for a student
3. Enter a string of 200+ characters in the Submission Comments field
test_cases.expected_result: Submission Comments field displays the entered long text or truncates it with a visible indicator

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in Submission Comments
steps: 2. Click on the Submission Comments field for a student
3. Enter special characters (e.g., @#$%^&*()!) in the Submission Comments field
test_cases.expected_result: Submission Comments field accepts the special characters without error

test_cases.test_case: Enter leading and trailing whitespace in Submission Comments
steps: 2. Click on the Submission Comments field for a student
3. Enter a value with leading and trailing spaces in the Submission Comments field
test_cases.expected_result: Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed; saved value shown in the detail page has no extra spaces

test_cases.test_case: Rapid re-submission after opening grading workflow
steps: 1. Click on the 'Open Grading Workflow' action for a student
2. After the grading workflow opens, quickly click the 'Open Grading Workflow' action again
test_cases.expected_result: The second action attempt is blocked; the grading workflow does not open a second time until the first is closed

test_cases.test_case: Edit a grade entry successfully
steps: 1. Click the three-dot menu on a grade cell
2. Enter <valid grade> in the grade cell
test_cases.expected_result: The grade cell updates to the entered <valid grade> and displays 'applies edits'

test_cases.test_case: Edit grade settings for an activity
steps: 1. Click the action menu on the Grade Column header
test_cases.expected_result: The grade settings are updated and reflected in the Grade Column

test_cases.test_case: Filter grades by group
steps: 1. Select 'Group 1' from the Group Filter dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: The grade table displays only rows for students in 'Group 1'; unrelated rows are no longer visible

test_cases.test_case: Search for a user in the gradebook
steps: 1. Enter <valid student name> in the User Search field
test_cases.expected_result: The grade table displays only rows for <valid student name>; unrelated rows are no longer visible

test_cases.test_case: View overall average row
steps: 1. Verify the overall average row is visible
test_cases.expected_result: The overall average row shows the class average per activity

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to save changes with grades outside the configured range
steps: 1. Edit a grade cell to a value outside the configured grade range
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; grades are not saved; error shown indicating 'Cannot save if values are outside configured grade range'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to save changes with all grades outside the configured range
steps: 1. Edit all grade cells to values outside the configured grade range
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; grades are not saved; error shown indicating 'Cannot save if values are outside configured grade range'

test_cases.test_case: Edit grade cell with minimum valid grade value
steps: 2. Enter the minimum valid grade value in the grade cell
test_cases.expected_result: Changes are saved successfully; the grade cell displays the minimum valid grade value.

test_cases.test_case: Edit grade cell with maximum valid grade value
steps: 2. Enter the maximum valid grade value in the grade cell
test_cases.expected_result: Changes are saved successfully; the grade cell displays the maximum valid grade value.

test_cases.test_case: Edit grade cell with value below minimum valid grade
steps: 2. Enter a value below the minimum valid grade in the grade cell
test_cases.expected_result: Saving is blocked; an inline error indicates the value is outside the configured grade range.

test_cases.test_case: Edit grade cell with value above maximum valid grade
steps: 2. Enter a value above the maximum valid grade in the grade cell
test_cases.expected_result: Saving is blocked; an inline error indicates the value is outside the configured grade range.

test_cases.test_case: Enter a very long profile description
steps: 2. Enter a string of 200+ characters in the Profile Description field
test_cases.expected_result: Profile Description field accepts the input without error; the saved value shows the entire string

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in the email address field
steps: 2. Enter 'user!@example.com' in the Email Address field
test_cases.expected_result: Email Address field displays an error indicating invalid email format

test_cases.test_case: Enter leading and trailing whitespace in the email address field
steps: 2. Enter '   user@example.com   ' in the Email Address field
test_cases.expected_result: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed; saved value shown in the detail page has no extra spaces

test_cases.test_case: Update profile with valid information
steps: 2. Enter <valid first name> in the First Name field
3. Enter <valid last name> in the Last Name field
4. Enter <valid email> in the Email Address field
test_cases.expected_result: The profile page refreshes to show the updated information

test_cases.test_case: Cancel profile edit without changes
test_cases.expected_result: Exits without making changes

test_cases.test_case: Leave the First Name field blank and submit
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the First_Name field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Last Name field blank and submit
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Last_Name field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Email Address field blank and submit
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Email_Address field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Submit with all required fields empty
test_cases.expected_result: Form does not submit; errors shown on First_Name, Last_Name, and Email_Address fields indicating they are required

test_cases.test_case: Enter an invalid email format and submit
steps: 1. Enter <invalid email format> in the Email_Address field
test_cases.expected_result: Email_Address field displays an error: 'Must be a valid email address'

test_cases.test_case: Enter valid email address at the edge of format validation
steps: 1. Enter 'user@example.com' in the Email Address field
2. Fill all other required fields with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; profile is updated with the email 'user@example.com'

test_cases.test_case: Enter an invalid email address format
steps: 1. Enter 'user@.com' in the Email Address field
2. Fill all other required fields with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: Email Address displays an error indicating the format is invalid

test_cases.test_case: Upload a file at the maximum size limit for New Picture
steps: 1. Upload a file that meets the maximum size limit in the New Picture field
2. Fill all other required fields with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; profile is updated with the new picture

test_cases.test_case: Upload a file exceeding the maximum size limit for New Picture
steps: 1. Upload a file that exceeds the maximum size limit in the New Picture field
2. Fill all other required fields with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: New Picture displays an error indicating the file size exceeds the limit

test_cases.test_case: Enter a very long string in the Description field
steps: 1. Enter a string of 200+ characters in the Description field
2. Fill all other required fields with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; profile is updated with the long description

test_cases.test_case: Enter special characters in the First Name field
steps: 1. Enter '@John!' in the First Name field
2. Fill all other required fields with valid data
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; profile is updated with the first name '@John!'

test_cases.test_case: User logs out successfully
test_cases.expected_result: terminates the current authenticated session and redirects to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log out while unauthenticated
steps: 1. Attempt to click the Logout button
test_cases.expected_result: Logout action is blocked; user remains on the current page without being logged out
